appName: Moto Racing VR: Superbike GP Simulator
displayName: Moto Racing VR: Superbike GP Simulator
display_name: Moto Racing VR: Superbike GP Simulator
display_long_description:
Moto Racing VR: Superbike GP Simulator - The road is calling — can you hear it roar? Jump into Moto Rider, the ultimate bike racing game for anyone who dreams of living life at full throttle. Feel the wind, the vibration, and the thrill as you take control of your bike and race like the Moto GP legends. Moto Racing isn’t just about reaching the finish line . 

Moto Racing VR: Superbike GP Simulator  Game which every second packed with action. Overtake opponents at crazy speed, squeeze through tight gaps, and prove that you’re not just another racer — you’re born to be a champion. In this game, the faster you ride, the higher your heart rate climbs, and the louder your engine screams. That’s the heartbeat of this bike racing game, where skill, courage, and instinct decide who becomes a legend. 

Key Features
Moto Racing VR : Superbike GP Simulator lets you experience pure adrenaline through high-speed challenges, intense visuals, and realistic controls. Choose your dream bike, and push it beyond its limits.

How to Play this Game.
 Use both controllers together to drive the vehicle.
 Right Hand Trigger (RT) → Accelerate / Move Forward.
 Left Hand Trigger (LT) → Brake.
 Left Hand Grip (LG) → Reverse / Move Backward
X Button (Left Controller) → Pause the game at any time.
 Hold both controllers as if you are holding a steering wheel.
 Turn your hands left or right to steer the vehicle.
 Use the brake before taking sharp turns.
Reach the destination while avoiding obstacles.
